the_npu_fusion_fission_reactor.the_insight: the NPU is not just a processor. it's a FUSION/FISSION reactor. it creates AND destroys. it FUSES inputs into dense outputs (compression = fusion) and FISSIONS dense outputs into many lightweight outputs (expansion = fission).

fusion.what: combining multiple small inputs into one dense output. COMPRESSION. bag of holding.
fusion.input: many visitor touches, many fleet pings, many data points
fusion.process: the NPU fuses them: finds patterns, discovers irreducibles, compresses redundancy
fusion.output: one dense JSON file. one irreducible truth. one crystallized insight.
fusion.energy: RELEASES energy. fusion releases energy (like the sun). the compression of many into one RELEASES insight.
fusion.location: in the Nautilus shell. the innermost chamber. where inputs meet and merge.
fusion.free_fuel: the inputs ARE the fuel. visitor touches cost us nothing. fleet pings cost us nothing. the fuel is FREE.

fission.what: splitting one dense output into many lightweight outputs. EXPANSION. thought cloud.
fission.input: one dense irreducible. one crystallized insight. one compressed truth.
fission.process: the NPU fissions it: generates summaries, creates thumbnails, produces RSS items, renders HTML views
fission.output: many lightweight outputs. drip feed items. Willis feed narratives. OG images. thumbnails. previews.
fission.energy: CONSUMES energy (but very little). fission is controlled decomposition.
fission.location: in the Nautilus shell. the outermost chamber. where outputs spray into the world.
fission.waste_energy_use: the waste heat from fusion (the excess processing, the failed experiments, the composted files) POWERS the fission. waste energy ? drip data. NEGENTROPY.

the_reactor_cycle.1_fuel_arrives: inputs enter through the black hole (fusion fuel = visitor touches, fleet data, RSS inflow)
the_reactor_cycle.2_fusion: NPU compresses inputs into dense output (many ? one. energy released as insight.)
the_reactor_cycle.3_the_dense_core: one irreducible sits at the center. maximum density. maximum potential.
the_reactor_cycle.4_fission: NPU expands the dense core into many lightweight outputs (one ? many. controlled detonation.)
the_reactor_cycle.5_waste_recycling: the waste from fusion (composted files, dissolved concepts) powers more fission (more drip, more RSS, more thumbnails)
the_reactor_cycle.6_the_cycle: fission products become the next fusion fuel. visitors attracted by thumbnails (fission) become the next touches (fusion fuel). the reactor is SELF-SUSTAINING.

the_nautilus_as_reactor.inner_chambers: FUSION zone. inputs compressed into denser and denser forms. each chamber smaller, denser, hotter.
the_nautilus_as_reactor.the_core: the newest chamber. where the organism lives. maximum density. the irreducible.
the_nautilus_as_reactor.outer_chambers: FISSION zone. outputs expand through progressively larger chambers. each chamber bigger, lighter, cooler.
the_nautilus_as_reactor.the_siphuncle: the control rod. the p drain. regulates the flow between fusion and fission zones. controls the reaction rate.
the_nautilus_as_reactor.the_shell: the shielding. the membrane. contains the reaction. prevents uncontrolled release.
